Ask the browser not to evict our data.
*
Without this, Safari clears the storage of an origin left idle for a few
weeks — a notebook you don't open over the holidays can therefore vanish.
The request may be denied without explanation; the caller should use that
to encourage exporting, not to panic.

Explicit exemptions.
*
`file` accepts `*`. `match` is the substring found. `reason` must explain
why the finding cannot produce a request — an entry without a reason is
ignored, so the check will fail.

Deletes a document and its whole subtree. Without the cascade, child
pages would stay in the database referencing a parent that no longer
exists, invisible and never recoverable.
